verdict.rationale: Teller's own site publishes a headline coverage figure of more than 7,000 financial institutions, with same-day ACH microdeposit fallback for others. The evidence shows no published institution list or searchable directory, and no explicit current statement of geography, so a founder cannot check coverage against their users' specific banks. The only named-bank list is an old community launch post covering a handful of UK banks, which is not current first-party coverage documentation. missing for 10: searchable or published per-institution coverage list, explicit documented geographies or countries served, per-institution capability or reliability data, independent corroboration of the 7,000 figure.

support.subject: As a founder, the platform documents how many institutions it reaches and where — published coverage numbers and geographies I can check against where my users actually bank

citations.quote: Connect instantly with more than 7,000 financial institutions and fall back to same-day ACH microdeposit verification for everyone else.
Teller is available today for Santander UK, Barclays, Natwest, Nationwide, RBS, Isle of Man Bank, and Ulster Bank.
